Gate runs dirty .jit/issues on main; commit gate state before running dispatch-worker-worktree.sh (it refuses a dirty main).

Count merge subjects with a script before committing; a 72-char lane merge forced a main rewrite. Tag a multi-issue merge with the issue that owns its out-of-region edits and keep other jit:<id> tags out of the body; reviewers attribute every commit whose message contains jit:<id>.
Run cargo-ci before code-review on Rust issues; code-review fails REQ evidence while cargo-ci is pending.
Delete worker branches that fast-forwarded old main after any main rewrite; reviewers found the stale commit through them.
Worktree .jit is a dispatch-time snapshot: workers must read live tracker state from the main checkout (read-only).

Cache-pool seeding copies target/ with absolute paths of other worktrees baked in; tests reading CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR and cargo doc search.index fail. Fix: cargo clean -p <crate> and rm target/doc in the worktree, CARGO_CI_NO_SCCACHE=1.
